# Table
Table is a family of three parts: Table head (this set), Table cell and Table row. Compose them into a header row, body rows and an optional caption below. Sorting, row selection, column visibility and pagination are not part of Table; they belong to a later DataTable. See the Data Table example and Usage frame on this page.

The column header cell of a table. Names a column and, when the data can be sorted, shows a sort control.

USE WHEN
• Labelling a column in a table header row
• A column can be sorted: Sort = unsorted | ascending | descending shows a ghost Button with an arrow icon
• A row-selection column needs a select-all Checkbox: Content = checkbox

DON'T USE WHEN
• The cell sits in a table body - use Table cell
• The label needs its own actions or filters - put those in the toolbar above the table

DO
• Keep labels to one or two words; truncate rather than wrap
• Set Align = end for numeric columns so figures line up with their cells
• Show only the current sort on one column at a time

DON'T
• Mix Sort states that imply two sorted columns
• Use Sort = none on a column the table can actually sort

PROPERTIES
Content: text | checkbox. Align: start | end (logical, flips in RTL). Sort: none (not sortable) | unsorted | ascending | descending. Text: string, used when Sort = none; a sortable head's label is edited on the nested Button.

TOKENS
Height 40 (spacing/10); padding-inline spacing/2; gap spacing/1_5; font-size/sm medium foreground. Sort control: Button ghost sm. The header row's bottom border (border, border-width/1) belongs to the row, not the cell.

## API

```tsx
import { Table, TableHeader, TableBody, TableFooter, TableRow, TableHead, TableCell, TableCaption } from "@atlas/ui-web/primitives/Table/Table"
```

**Table**

- no own props

**TableHeader**
- ref: not forwarded — `ref` does not type-check; reach the element by `id`
- no own props

**TableCell** — also accepts native `<tablecell>` attributes (except align)
